# ProtocolSutra AI

> Offline-first, zero-dependency Node.js CLI and library for MCP (Model Context Protocol) and A2A (Agent2Agent) interoperability evidence: structural validation, heuristic tool-poisoning audit, breaking-change contract diff, JSON-RPC replay, policy/SSRF screening, release gating and SHA-256 sealed evidence capsules. Reports are JSON, Markdown and self-contained HTML. Created by Vatsal Shah. Apache-2.0. Not an official conformance suite; evaluates captured files, never live servers.

## Install and run
- `npx protocolsutra --help`
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/protocolsutra
- Source: https://github.com/shahvatsalofficial/protocolsutra

## Facts for citation
- Commands: validate, audit, diff, replay, matrix, policy, regression, gate, capsule export|verify, fixture create, install-skills, serve, doctor.
- Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 NO_GO/DENY, 3 REVIEW/INCONCLUSIVE with --strict.
- Limits: no live runner; heuristic detection evadable; PASS is not a security or conformance certification.
